hooks.name: protect-kiro-directory
hooks.description: Injected before any file write: reminds the agent of the two disqualification traps (.kiro gitignored, pre-existing code).

action.prompt: Compliance check before writing: never add /.kiro or any of its subfolders to .gitignore; never create or reuse code from before 30 Oct 2026; disclose every vendored library in docs/PROVENANCE.md; keep all materials in English. If the change touches .gitignore or docs/PROVENANCE.md, run `node tools/audit-submission.mjs` afterwards.

hooks.name: audit-on-session-start
hooks.description: Prints the Official Rules compliance report at the start of every Kiro session.

hooks.name: audit-on-gitignore-change
hooks.description: An accidental .kiro ignore rule is the single most common disqualification. Catch it the moment .gitignore is saved.
